wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.title: Equipment, model properties and ranged attacks
wolffsmodnpcs.category.equipment.help: Equipped items, model properties and weapon stats
wolffsmodnpcs.category.firing.help: Projectiles, grenades, muzzles and weapon banks
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.item_armor.help: Armor slots govern native protection, toughness, enchantments, durability, attributes and Flan armor effects. Resistance controls show a read-only preview; their saved values do not drive combat. No restores NPC armor behavior.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.item_weapons.help: The primary weapon governs real attacks, including item attributes, enchantments, arrows, loaded Flan magazines, throwing and shield use. Projectile slot supplies ammunition. Item readouts never change saved NPC stats. Takes precedence over model weapon inheritance. No restores NPC attacks.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.armor_animations.h: Animate equipped armor with the NPC's limbs. No keeps armor in its resting pose while preserving protection and rendering.
Show equipped weapon aiming, charging, blocking and shooting poses. No suppresses added equipment poses without changing real attacks or shield protection.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.type_properties.he: Read supported properties from the selected AA gun, mecha, plane or vehicle type. Show inherited values read-only in the standard editor. No restores saved NPC defaults. Weapon statistics and sounds also respect their separate switches.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.projectiles.help: Fire real Flan bullets and grenades from the projectile slot. No restores the normal Custom NPCs projectile.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.grenades.help: Throw real grenades with their content-defined fuse, bounce and explosion. No uses the normal Custom NPCs projectile for grenades.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.model_muzzles.help: Launch from the selected Flan model's weapon positions, including NPC size and AA barrels. No launches from eye height.
Honor alternating weapon banks and AA barrels; cycle twin and quad mounts. No fires all barrels together.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.weapon_stats.help: For model/template attacks, use the mounted or held gun's damage, spread, speed, attachments and pellet count. No uses NPC weapon defaults. Use equipped weapons always executes the item regardless of this switch. Ammunition ballistics always apply.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.flan_sounds.help: Use content firing, reload and grenade throw sounds. No mutes equipped Flan weapons; model/template attacks use the saved NPC firing sound. Projectile hit and explosion sounds retain their definitions.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.shoot_particles.he: Emit the selected bank's authored muzzle particles, with a small flame when none are defined. Projectile trails and explosions retain their definitions.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.lead_target.help: Aim ahead using the target's current velocity and the round's flight time.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.ballistic_aim.help: Compensate for projectile gravity and air drag. Indirect attacks prefer a high arc. No aims directly while retaining real projectile physics.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.secondary_bank.hel: Use the model's secondary weapon positions, statistics, sounds and particles. No uses its primary weapon. One bank fires per ranged attack.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.ammo_hint: Primary weapon + armor slots; ammunition in Projectile. Hover grey values.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.notice: Grey values: controlled by equipment or Flan definitions.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.item_wea: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Use equipped weapons. The item executes its real attack; these readouts are display only. Damage previews use a generic target and loaded ammunition; impacts may vary by target or belt round. Delay includes native charging. Unknown values show Item behavior. Saved NPC values return when this switch is disabled.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.item_arm: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Use equipped armor. Native equipment, enchantments and Flan armor effects drive protection; saved NPC resistance values are inactive. Percentage sliders preview a ten-HP hit because armor is nonlinear. Flan bullet defense is resolved separately by the ammunition damage path. Disable this switch to restore your NPC settings.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.notice.h: Hover a grey control for its source. Inherited model properties display converted type values. Other overridden controls retain their inactive NPC fallback. Saved NPC defaults are preserved.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.type_pro: Read from the selected Flan model type through Wolff's Mod > Use model properties, converted to Custom NPCs units and limits. Weapon fields are defaults before ammunition modifies them. Disable inheritance to restore your saved NPC values. Native shot count is one trigger; Flan supplies barrels and pellets.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.weapon_s: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Flan weapon stats. This is your saved NPC fallback, not the active Flan weapon value. Disable Flan weapon stats to use this fallback again.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.ammuniti: Controlled by the Flan ammunition while Wolff's Mod > Flan projectiles is enabled. This saved NPC value is inactive. Disable Flan projectiles, or Flan grenades for grenade ammunition, to restore the ordinary projectile controls.
wolffsmodnpcs.weapons.read_only.firing_s: Controlled by Wolff's Mod > Flan firing sounds. This is your saved NPC sound. Disable Flan firing sounds to use it again.
